description: This Java class defines a REST controller for exporting book data for the current user in a book tracking application. It handles HTTP GET requests at '/api/export-books-data' and utilizes UserService to get the current user and BookExportService to export the user's book data.

classes.name: BookExportController
classes.description: A REST controller that provides an endpoint to export the current user's book data.

methods.name: exportBooksData
methods.description: Handles GET requests to export the current user's book data by invoking the BookExportService.
